tasks.title: Status adopts the contract patch after #809 and passes its existing checks
tasks.spec: ## Repository: status, R7, all preconditions and Completion evidence; Rollout step 2; Security impact dependency pins; Performance impact; Acceptance evidence 5. Before any edit require #809 closed, main's contract pin containing c5ce668, and current-pin-to-patch compare ahead; otherwise use the prescribed holds. Today's main already pins b637302 (2.5.0), so use ancestry rather than version equality. Preserve the native blocked-by #809 prerequisite for a person after fan-out. Performance: none expected, no measurement required.
